editorial.name: Teachable
editorial.descriptionZh: Teachable 是卖在线课程、会员、教练服务与数字下载的平台，把创作者从课程搭建、收款到学员管理都接起来。首页用自家后台截图演示课程是怎么建起来的。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它把课程后台的 Setup guide 当首屏演示
editorial.noteZh: 最上面一条黄绿色横条滚动播 Selling more than US$12k/yr outside Teachable? 与 Migrate this month and earn up to $6,500 in credits，还带 See migration offer 链接。下面是黑底导航，左边 teachable 小写字标，右边 Products、Resources、Pricing 与 Creator login、Contact sales、黄绿实心 Start for free。首屏米白底衬线大标题 The future of your education business happens here，副标写 Whatever your expertise—languages, fitness, or coding—Teachable helps you deliver impactful learning, run a smarter business, and scale worldwide.。再往下压着一整块后台截图，左栏是 Career Ready Ready 品牌下的 Setup guide、Curriculum、Design templates、Certificates，主区标题是 Courses | UX Career Launch: Portfolio to Paycheck 加一枚 PUBLISHED 标签，下面并排 Create your curriculum 与 Customize your course 两块，右侧表单里能看到 Course title、Thumbnail 与 Edit image。
editorial.pricing: freemium：首页有 Start for free 与 Explore our plans，价目在 /pricing

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Teachable 自己的产品演示、创作者规模与定价入口，没有可下载的模板或素材；候选池从 saaslandingpage.com 落地页灵感目录收进来，故归产品与公司官网。
导航是 Products、Resources、Pricing 加 Creator login，路径指向 /online-courses、/memberships、/site-builder 这类自家产品与后台说明，是平台对外的门面。
